stance_rationale: alpha_scores.parquet is genuinely time-series and F4 clears raw IC gates, but the package overclaims an asset-class impossibility from a narrow 5-spec grid while leaving mandatory DSR, challenge_note, C13/C15, sector-neutral, capacity, and triangulation gaps unresolved. Do not graduate or route to Risk/Optimizer until the package is revised as a NON_GRADUATING archive with explicit unresolved disputes.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Actual alpha_scores at stage_artifacts/WT_D20260514_002 has 282448 rows, 268 monthly business-end dates, no Date-Ticker duplicates, and variable tickers per date. User-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260514_002 path is absent; schema uses alpha_signal rather than score_* naming.

RF-A2.evidence: F5 composite ICIR=0.415 is below F2 single Amihud ICIR=0.614; selected F4 is single-signal, so composite value-add is not established.

RF-A3.evidence: F4 recent 3Y ICIR ratio is 1.12x full ICIR, below 1.5x trigger.

RF-A4.evidence: No sector-neutral, beta-neutral, or liquidity-neutral IC retention was computed.

RF-A5.evidence: alpha_scores does not carry ADV20 for audit; latest top decile median Size is 1.596B KRW and 42 names tie at the score ceiling, consistent with stale-price/low-vol liquidity risk.

RF-A6.evidence: DSR and full multi-testing/5-spec regression panel are explicitly deferred.

RF-A7.evidence: Multi-date alpha panel exists with 268 monthly sig_dates.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Engine creates z_neg_vol_60d and uses mean-IC-based flip_sign / abs(ICIR) selection logic. This is not Z_Score_Aligned-only and leaves manual sign-alignment risk.
No Factor DB IC table was loaded; no Usable_Date violation observed, but no Usable_Date audit artifact exists.
factor_engine_proposal.R directly read_parquet() loads .cache/rawdata.parquet and STR_1715 parquet; load_month_factors() path is not used.
vol_60d_t1 is computed with shift(..., n=1L), avoiding same-day vol use.
No fundamental fields are used in selected F4; C4 lag is not triggered.

critical_concerns.description: The package converts a 5-spec small/mid grid failure into a broad claim that KR equity asset-class orthogonality is a binding limit and that a 4th source may not exist. That is an AX-000 violation and an AX-002 overreach: N=5 alpha-stage search cannot prove impossibility.

Selected F4 fails the L-317 portfolio realized orthogonality mandate: Pearson 0.6957, Spearman 0.6942, Kendall 0.5118, lower-tail TDC 0.4815, only 1/6 axes pass. It cannot graduate as an orthogonal sleeve.
DSR and required multi-testing controls are deferred despite Harvey/DSR gates being mandatory. Extreme t_NW=19.277 is not sufficient when selection used a 5-spec grid and post-selection narrative.

C13 is not clean: the engine uses z_cs(-vol_60d_t1), z_neg_size, abs(ICIR), abs(Harvey), and mean-IC-based flip_sign logic. Even if selected F4 is economically low-vol, the framework permits post-hoc sign alignment.
C15/reproducibility is weak: direct parquet loads are used, artifact_lineage references run_all.R, but run_all.R is absent. The stated reproduction command is therefore not executable as recorded.

Universe and constraint overrides are not fully governed. Base hard universe is KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150, while this package expands to full KOSPI/KOSDAQ and request/package hard constraints show max_names/weight_bounds drift without a final policy amendment.

RF-A5 remains unresolved: ADV20 is not present in alpha_scores, latest top decile is very small-cap, and 42 names tie at the low-vol score ceiling. Stale-price low-vol can masquerade as alpha despite a nominal 2e8 KRW liquidity floor.

RF-A4 is unresolved because sector-neutral, beta-neutral, and liquidity-neutral IC retention were not run. A small-cap low-vol defense signal can be mostly beta/liquidity/sector exposure rather than independent alpha.

No challenge_note.md, alpha_package.json final, risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet exists for this WT; the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260514_002 directory is absent. AX-008 triangulation cannot pass.

Full 2004-2026 data including post-2024 lockbox period is used for selection and L-code conclusion without Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined reporting. Discovery status does not remove the need to separate the sealed lockbox before making methodology-level claims.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 single-snapshot bug is not present in the actual alpha_scores artifact: 268 monthly sig_dates and variable universe are present.
F4 raw alpha diagnostics clear rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey-t, monotonicity, and sub_stability gates before orthogonality and governance overlays.
The package honestly discloses Pareto 6-axis failure and labels the candidate NON_GRADUATING, which should remain the final status unless revised evidence changes the result.
unresolved_disputes: Whether F4 low-vol alpha survives sector/beta/liquidity neutralization.
Whether DSR >= 0.50 holds after ex-ante N=5 and any implicit sign/direction choices.
Whether full-universe expansion is authorized under the hard KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 mandate before a policy amendment.
Whether the high low-vol score ties are stale-price artifacts rather than investable alpha.
Whether lockbox-period data influenced selection or the proposed L-318 conclusion.
Whether downstream schedule/PSD checks can be performed, because weights.csv and covariance.parquet are absent.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that failure of this 5-spec small/mid universe-expansion grid proves a KR-equity asset-class orthogonality barrier or that a 4th orthogonal source may not exist.
rebuttal_required: Provide DSR, Harvey-Liu-Zhu adjusted evidence, and full 5-spec multi-testing accounting, not deferred-to-judge placeholders.
Rerun F4 with sector, beta, liquidity, and stale-price controls; report IC retention and top-decile liquidity/capacity.
Remove or formally justify all C13 sign-alignment logic and produce Z_Score_Aligned-compatible artifacts.
Fix artifact lineage so the recorded reproduction command exists and the expected stage_artifacts paths are consistent.
Add challenge_note.md explicitly covering RF-A1 through RF-A7 and the NON_GRADUATING decision.
Split results into Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined before proposing an L-code methodology lesson.
